title: E27 fault-injection scenario manifest
description: One per scenario directory (packages/fixtures/accounts/<scenario>/manifest.json): a key scenario, a rotation pair or an overlay (README). Every value is fabricated. Paths are relative to packages/fixtures/accounts/. Times are milliseconds relative to an injected now: the scenario start, which for a scenario switched in at runtime is the switch (README, scenario time). This subset has no conditionals, so which fields each kind carries is checked by scripts/accounts-pack.mjs. Only the keywords the vitest validator implements may appear here: type, required, properties, patternProperties, additionalProperties, enum, const, pattern, minLength, minimum, items, minItems, $ref.

scenario.description: Equals the directory name; selected as CV_ACCOUNT_FIXTURE=<scenario>.

origin.description: The test plan section 9.3 'Origin' column, verbatim; 'overlay' marks an overlay.

environment.description: The only environment the pack stubs; a live-host request is a defect.

extends.description: 'As <scenario>': every stub this manifest does not set is answered by that scenario.

switch_to.description: A runtime switch (#2893): until it the key answers as this manifest resolves, after it as the named key scenario, keeping this key's id and secret.

rotation.description: A rotation pair: the old and the new key each answer as the named key scenario. A rotation manifest carries no extends, switch_to, egress_ip, clock, rest or ws of its own.

tester_inputs.description: What a tester types; every key scenario and rotation pair has it, an overlay has none. The secret is never stored here: it is derived by the README rule fixture-<scenario>-secret-not-real.

egress_ip.description: What the deployment's IP echo check answers (SR-033): the egress IP a key's allowlist is judged against. RFC 5737 only; every key scenario resolves one through extends.

clock.description: Exchange-side times relative to the injected now; each field overrides the extended scenario's.

server_offset_ms.description: The stub exchange clock minus now: reply 'time', server time and header timestamps.

key_expires_offset_ms.description: Key info expiredAt minus now; null means no expiry.

rest.description: Stubbed REST calls keyed by '<METHOD> <path>'; '*' answers every call the scenario does not list. Lookup: this scenario's exact key, then its '*', then the extended scenario; a stub whose 'when' the request does not meet is passed over (README).

ws.description: The private WS script; each field overrides the extended scenario's.

after_auth.description: Frames sent after every successful auth, relative to that auth.

timeline.description: Connection events relative to the scenario start (the switch, for a scenario switched in at runtime); equal times run in list order.

expected.description: The black-box outcome, named as in the test plan; never an internal function or field. An overlay records outcome and cases only.

problem.description: Problem code, with the rule after a slash where the contract names one.

payloadPath.description: A JSON file in _base/, in a scenario directory, or in the shared corpus's rest/ folder.

merge_patch.description: RFC 7396 merge patch applied to the payload after the clock is applied.

when.description: A request matcher (README): the stub answers only a request whose JSON body is an object holding every field 'body' names, at its top level, with the same type and value, so true never matches "true" or 1. A field the body lacks never matches, nor does a request without a JSON object body; fields 'body' does not name are ignored. A stub that does not match is passed over for the next one in lookup order. scripts/accounts-pack.mjs refuses an empty 'body' and a matcher on a GET call, which carries no body.

body.description: Top-level request body fields and the value each must have: a string or a boolean (v5 order bodies carry quantities and prices as strings).

code_unconfirmed.description: The reply's retCode and retMsg could not be confirmed (README).
